paper_title: Prospects of nuclear-coupled-dark-matter detection via correlation spectroscopy of I2+ and Ca+
notes: Proposal/projection paper: proposes correlation spectroscopy between an I2+ molecular-ion vibrational transition and the Ca+ optical clock to search for oscillations of the proton-to-electron mass ratio induced by gluon-coupled ULDM. Figure 3 shows only projected sensitivities ('this work', thick red line) on the scalar-gluon coupling dg (panel a) and on the axion decay constant 1/fa (panel b), over roughly 10^-21 to 10^-14 eV. No measurement is performed and no new experimental limit is derived, so no data points are reported. Paper assumes local DM density rho_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3.
